message: I confirm the gap. Planning an ingress-level canonical working-activity fence: ordinary tool calls by the actual initiating Working agent advance its ledger version before executing the requested operation; correction CAS rejects stale observed versions, without touching target from observation or changing Working-turn timer/state. Will add multi-clone concurrent negative tests. Evaluating performance and writes that already update agent so we avoid self-conflicting expected versions. If you see a better canonical protocol that preserves exact CAS and avoids per-call Git writes, please send it.
